START.rule: Look up intent before reading a new HEAD. Repeated intent returns same run, including terminal states. Active different intent => ACTIVE_SCAN_EXISTS.

STATUS.rule: Get chosen scoped run or latest scoped run; return scan_run:null if no run. Never starts a page or auto-resumes.

STEP.rule: Atomic RUNNING/revision/cursor guard with page transaction. cursor>expected => current status/no page; cursor<expected => CURSOR_AHEAD; terminal states no page.

PAUSE.rule: Idempotent same-target PAUSE; prevents new pages after committed transition. Existing page may finish first.

CONTINUE.rule: Explicit current-revision PAUSED to RUNNING; already RUNNING returns same state without increment and allows a user-requested client pump after reconnect. Never revives CANCELLED/FAILED/BLOCKED/COMPLETE.

CANCEL.rule: Idempotent CANCELLED tombstone. No data deletion. Persisted state confirmed only after receipt/STATUS.

ids.intentKey: random lowercase hex (32 chars), generated once per explicit new START
ids.expectedCursor: nonnegative safe integer from authoritative STATUS; keep actual snapshot limits
ids.expectedRevision: nonnegative safe integer control revision; changes only on control-state transitions

request_effect: Data-only source scan plus existing store mutation; no source-code execution, cloud send or second worker.
serialization: Maximum one in-flight client STEP; state/cursor guards checked in the same SQLite transaction; one active intent per repository/profile.
control_uncertainty: UI local pause/stop stops scheduling immediately; backend transition may wait for existing page. Lost response requires STATUS. A late CONTINUE cannot remove newer pause/cancel.
coverage_notes: INDEXED binary means raw capture, not text extraction

failure_rules.SOURCE_DRIFT: Block existing run; preserve old pinned snapshot.
failure_rules.PROFILE_CHANGED: Block/scope-error; no new head under repeated old intent.
failure_rules.CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE: No COMPLETE run when ledger/proof corrupt.
failure_rules.CURSOR_AHEAD: Caller expected cursor beyond stored cursor; reject, do not skip.
failure_rules.CONTROL_REVISION_STALE: No control mutation; return current status/reconcile.
failure_rules.NO_PROGRESS: Stop client pump with explicit blocker; no endless retry.
failure_rules.NATIVE_TIMEOUT: STATUS before any further STEP/control; no blind replay loop.

response_payload.scan_run: Compact projection object; STATUS may return null when no scoped run exists. File pages remain on legacy durable.repo.get.
response_payload.start_outcome: For START only: CREATED, REUSED_INTENT, or ACTIVE_SCAN_EXISTS. Active-conflict response exposes only the already-authorized active run reference; does not start the new intent.
